    nx2 = 1 + 1/M
    
    # Corresponding structure factors S ~ i * f * N^3 * (pi * epsilon / a)
    # We omit f and N^3 as they are standard scaling factors, focusing on the 
    # dependence on epsilon, a, and the integer order.
    
    # Structure factor S is proportional to i * pi * epsilon / a
    S = sp.I * sp.pi * epsilon / a
    
    allowed = {

        (nx2, -S)  # The sign depends on the sideband (+/- Q order), corresponding to expansion of sin(Qx)
    }
    
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------
    
    return allowed
